commitResults.messageTitle: Janet.java: Add ability to store and display tasks

commitResults.messageBody:
Janet stores task descriptions as plain strings, preventing task-specific state from being added cleanly.

Create a Task class and use it for in-memory task storage.

Encapsulate each task’s description and completion status for future done-task functionality.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ability to mark task as done
Split input validation into new function
commitResults.messageBody:
markTask() contains task lookup, input parsing, and validation logic.

Extract task lookup and validation into a reusable getTask() helper.

Reuse the helper so markTask() is shorter and task selection logic can also support future functions

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ability to mark task as undone
Add test-ui skill to test code
Add ToDos as new type of task
Add Deadlines as new type of task
Add Events as new type of task

commitResults.messageBody:
Janet duplicates storage, capacity checks, and confirmation output for each task type.

Extract the shared behavior into an addTask() helper.

Reuse the helper for regular tasks, to-dos, deadlines, and events while keeping command-specific parsing in main().

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle Janet-specific errors with custom exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Janet prints error messages directly throughout command processing.

Create JanetException subclasses for task limits, invalid commands, and invalid task numbers.

Throw typed exceptions from the relevant operations and handle them centrally in the command loop.

Janet accepts empty task descriptions and treats unknown input as a regular task.

Reject empty structured commands and unrecognised commands with clear Janet-specific errors.

Validate input before creating tasks and update the UI test plan to use the required command syntax.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update README.md to reflect AI usage
Restrict tasks to concrete task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Janet’s base Task class can be instantiated even though only todos, deadlines and events are supported.

Make Task abstract and require concrete subclasses to provide their type icons.

Remove generic-task checks and confirmations so Janet only stores the three supported task subclasses.
